title: The Quiet Rival
summary: A rival god stirs on the far shore — chaotic, wrathful, but not yet bold. Take the island before it finds its nerve.
briefing: You are not alone on this island.
The other god is a chaotic thing, and its temper will show in the sky.
Grow your people, hold ground, and finish what it starts.

quests.title: Take root
quests.description: Grow your people and hold the land around them.

objectives.text: Pave roads to bind your settlements

quests.title: Survive the drought
quests.description: The rival's chaos will wither your ground. Bring the water back.

objectives.text: Restore the ruined land with water

quests.title: Answer the rival
quests.description: Meet the other god's works with your own.

objectives.text: Arm your people with crafted tools
